[SWS_CM_00813]
ara::com
implementation to call
StopOfferService()
within destruction of Skeleton explicitly
⌈
The
ara::com
implementation of the Ser-
vice Skeleton destructor shall call
StopOfferService()
explicitly to make sure the
service is not offered after the skeleton is destroyed. [SWS_CM_00083] still applies to
avoid destruction failures.
⌋
